proposals.before: In the twelfth year (1886) the emperor assumed personal rule and ordered repairs to the Old Summer Palace for the empress dowager's residence.
proposals.after: In the twelfth year (1873) the emperor assumed personal rule and ordered repairs to the Old Summer Palace for the empress dowager's residence.
proposals.reason: Tongzhi 12 corresponds to AD 1873 (Yuanmingyuan repair debate under Tongzhi), not Guangxu 12 / 1886.

proposals.before: Lately the two Hu provinces have been held up chiefly by a few scholar-officials—Hu Linyi and Luo Zinan—who drilled their men in courage and led from the front.
proposals.after: Lately the two Hu provinces have been held up chiefly by a few scholar-officials—Hu Linyi and Luo Zenan—who drilled their men in courage and led from the front.
proposals.reason: 羅澤南 is Luo Zenan; Zinan is incorrect romanization of 澤南.

decisions.reason: s0208 places 十二年 with 上親政 and 葺治圓明園 for the empress dowager, immediately followed by Shen Huai's and You Baichuan's remonstrance—the Tongzhi-era Yuanmingyuan repair debate. Tongzhi 12 is AD 1873; the prior parenthetical 1886 wrongly treats the year as Guangxu 12.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 十二年，上親政，命葺治圓明園，奉皇太后駐蹕。

decisions.reason: s0017 names 羅澤南 beside 胡林翼; 澤南 is Zenan, not Zinan. The proposed idiomatic correction restores the standard romanization without changing the rest of the sentence.

claimRevisions.reason: Accepted r0002 shows English Luo Zinan came only from the bad romanization of 羅澤南; the personal-name claim must read Luo Zenan while keeping zh, pinyin, id, subject, predicate, certainty, and evidence.
